name: Shield

casting_time.trigger: you are hit by an attack roll or targeted by the Magic Missile spell

summary: Reaction: +5 AC until the start of your next turn, even against the triggering attack, and Magic Missile can't hurt you.
text: Reaction, taken when an attack roll hits you or you are targeted by Magic Missile. Until the start of your next turn you have a +5 bonus to AC, which counts against the triggering attack, and you take no damage from Magic Missile.
